whatIs.title: What is Use Sybil?
body: Use Sybil is pre-accounting software for Belgian business owners: owners of a management company, freelancers and small companies. Sybil, the assistant inside the app, reads your receipts, bills, e-invoices and contracts, files each one as Professional or Personal, matches it to its bank payment and applies Belgian VAT and deductibility rules.

Every quarter she hands your accountant a closed quarter: a register, numbered proofs and the original e-invoices. Pro costs {pro} and ManCo {manco} per month, excluding VAT. The free trial needs no card.

faq.title: Before you start.
faq.lead: Something else? Ask Sybil in the free trial, or write to us.

items.a: No. Sybil prepares, your accountant signs off. She saves them time by handing over a closed, complete quarter.
Hosted in the EU, encrypted, never used to train AI. You see every access and can lock documents Sybil shouldn't read.

items.q: How long are my documents kept?
items.a: {vaultYears} years in the vault. Each completed year comes back to you as a full, indexed export to archive. Your accountant can tell you how long the law asks you to keep them.

items.q: Business and personal in one app?
items.a: Yes. Every document lands in the right world, and personal documents never go to your accountant.
You pick Pro or ManCo. If you don't, your account turns read-only and everything stays in your vault.

items.q: How much does Use Sybil cost?
items.a: Pro costs {pro} per month and ManCo {manco} per month, both excluding VAT. Pro includes {proAccounts} connected bank accounts or cards, ManCo includes {mancoAccounts}. Each extra one is {extra} per month, only while it is connected. The free trial needs no card and runs until {trialDocuments} documents or your first report.

Belgian business owners who handle their own paperwork: owners of a management company, freelancers and small companies. Pro fits freelancers and small companies. ManCo adds everything around contracts: notice dates, cancel reminders, a payment calendar and pay in one tap.

items.q: Does Use Sybil handle Peppol e-invoices?
items.a: Yes. Both plans include invoicing and Peppol. Sybil keeps the original e-invoice and passes it on to your accountant with the quarter.

items.q: Does Sybil tell me what to do?
items.a: No. Sybil gives facts and dates, such as a notice period that opens or a bank account that changed, and you decide. She never recommends a product and never sells your data.

security.title: Your paperwork, kept safe and kept yours.
security.lead: Use Sybil reads your bills, receipts, contracts and bank lines. This page lists how that data is kept, who can see it and how you get it back.

sections.title: Hosted in the EU
sections.text: Your documents and data are stored and processed in the European Union.

sections.title: Encrypted
sections.text: Your data is encrypted on its way to Use Sybil and where it is stored.

sections.title: Never used to train AI
sections.text: Your documents are read to do your admin. They are never used to train AI models.

sections.title: You see every access
sections.text: An access log shows who opened what, and when. You find it in Settings, under Security.

sections.title: Lock what Sybil should not read
sections.text: You can lock a document. A locked document stays in your vault and Sybil does not read it.

sections.title: {vaultYears} years in the vault, then yours
sections.text: Documents stay in your vault for {vaultYears} years. Each time a year is complete, you receive a full, indexed export, including the original e-invoices, to keep in your own archive. Your accountant can tell you how long the law asks you to keep them.

sections.title: Personal stays personal
sections.text: Every document is filed as Professional or Personal. Personal documents never go to your accountant.

sections.title: Paid by you, and only by you
sections.text: Use Sybil is paid for by its customers. Sybil never sells data and never pushes a product.

sections.title: A stop before a wrong payment
sections.text: When Sybil can't vouch for who you are paying (an unknown supplier, a changed bank account, an account name that doesn't match), she puts the payment on hold until you confirm.

accountants.title: Your client prepares. You sign off.
accountants.lead: Use Sybil does the sorting, matching and chasing before anything reaches you. You receive a closed, complete quarter, ready for your own software.

pack.title: A closed quarter
pack.text: Your client closes the quarter once every proof is matched to its payment, then sends it to you in one tap.

pack.title: The register, as CSV
pack.text: One line per proof, numbered like the proofs themselves.

pack.title: Numbered proofs
pack.text: Each receipt and bill as a PDF, numbered to match its line in the register.

pack.title: Original e-invoices
pack.text: Peppol e-invoices as received or sent, in their original UBL format, next to their PDF.

pack.title: A VAT summary
pack.text: The quarter totals, with VAT and net amounts labelled in words.

accountants.professionalText: Your client keeps business and personal paperwork in one app. The pack sent to you is always Professional only: personal documents never leave their vault.
how: Each value shows where it came from: read by Sybil, confirmed by your client, or verified against the bank.
Deductibility and VAT follow Belgian rules. Where Sybil could not read something, she asks your client before the quarter closes.
Sybil gives facts, never advice. The books, the filings and the sign-off stay with you.
accountants.deliveryText: The pack is sent to your document inbox, the address your client sets once in Use Sybil.
